newsitem.title: PERU: Four die in Peruvian army clash with Shining Path.
newsitem.headline: Four die in Peruvian army clash with Shining Path.

text.p: Three rebels and one soldier died in a clash between the Peruvian army and Shining Path guerrillas in the Maoist group's key stronghold in the jungle highlands, military officials said on Friday.

The clash occurred after a civil self-defence group armed with shotguns fought on Wednesday with a group of rebels trying to take food supplies from an isolated village in the department of Ayacucho 415 miles (665 km) southeast of Lima.

Soldiers who came to support the villagers battled with the guerrillas until they retreated to their hideouts in the hills, an army official said in a telephone interview from Ayacucho. The rebels also shot one soldier in the chest, he said.

Security force sources said clashes in the area had become more frequent in recent weeks as the army tried to flush the rebels out of the nearby Vizcatan zone, where it believes the group's field commander, Oscar Ramirez, operates.
